senses.gloss: रिश् रिश् (cf. लिश्), i. 6, Par. To hurt.

रिष् रिष्, i. 1 and 4, Par.
 1. To kill, to hurt, MBh. 3, 13111.
 2. To give offence, Man. 4, 178, Ātm. (Sch., but perhaps pass. To be hurt).
 3. To be hurt (ved.).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रिष्ट.
 1. Injured.
 2. Unlucky, n.
 1. Bad luck.
 2. Destruction.
 3. Sin. m.
 1. A sword (cf. ऋष्टि).
 2. The name of a demon.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. probably ῥαίω, ῥαιστός; Lat. lædo.
रिशादस् रिशादस्, probably रिश् + अ-अद् + अस्, adj. m. A destroyer of those who injure, Chr. 290, 5 = Rigv. i. 64, 5.
रिश्य रिश् + य, m. A deer, see ऋष्य.

रिष्टि रिष्टि,
 I. f. m. A sword (cf. ऋष्टि).
 II. रिष् + ति, f. Bad luck.
